en:
positional arguments:
  extract (e)     Extract archives
  watch (w)       Manage watched folders and the background service
  scan (s)        Inspect archives and confirm passwords
  passwords (pw)  Show extraction passwords
  config (cfg)    Show or validate config
  doctor (d)      Check the installation
  version (ver)   Show the version

options:
  -h/--help       Show help
en.extract:
positional arguments:
  paths                              Input files or folders

options:
  -h/--help                          Show help
  -j/--json                          Output JSON
  -v/--verbose                       Show detailed output
  --no-pause                         Exit immediately when finished
  --pause                            Wait for a key press before exit
  -R/--recursive                     Discover files recursively in input directories
  -d/--deep-detect                   Scan all unresolved files for embedded archives, including nested rounds
  -p/--password PASSWORD             Archive password; repeatable
  -P/--pw-file PASSWORD_FILE         Password file; one password per line
  -a/--ask-pw                        Enter passwords interactively
  --no-builtin-pw/--no-bpw           Disable built-in passwords
  -r/--recur RECURSIVE_EXTRACT       Extraction rounds: positive integer, * unlimited, ? prompt
  -c/--cleanup ARCHIVE_CLEANUP_MODE  Source archives: d delete, r recycle, k keep
  -o/--out-dir OUTPUT_DIR            Output root; defaults to the current directory
  -f/--flatten                       Flatten a single top-level directory
  -F/--no-flatten                    Preserve the extracted directory structure
  --direct-file/--direct             Analyze input files directly as archives
en.watch:
positional arguments:
  start         Start the watch service
  add           Add watched folders
  remove (rm)   Remove watched folders
  list (ls)     List watched folders
  reload        Reload the watch service
  rebuild-log   Clear display logs and rebuild from watch state/WAL
  stop          Stop the watch service
  status (st)   Show watch service status
  startup       Manage Windows autostart

options:
  -h/--help     Show help
  -j/--json     Output JSON
  -v/--verbose  Show detailed output
  --no-pause    Exit immediately when finished
  --pause       Wait for a key press before exit
en.watch start:
options:
  -h/--help     Show help
  -j/--json     Output JSON
  -v/--verbose  Show detailed output
  --no-pause    Exit immediately when finished
  --pause       Wait for a key press before exit
  --once        Run one watch pass
  --no-tray     Hide the tray icon
en.watch add:
positional arguments:
  paths                    Folders to add or remove

options:
  -h/--help                Show help
  -j/--json                Output JSON
  -v/--verbose             Show detailed output
  --no-pause               Exit immediately when finished
  --pause                  Wait for a key press before exit
  -o/--out-dir OUTPUT_DIR  Watched folder output root
  -s/--start               Start watching after adding folders
  -R/--recursive           Discover files recursively in input directories
  -d/--deep-detect         Scan all unresolved files in added folders for embedded archives
en.watch remove:
positional arguments:
  paths         Folders to add or remove

options:
  -h/--help     Show help
  -j/--json     Output JSON
  -v/--verbose  Show detailed output
  --no-pause    Exit immediately when finished
  --pause       Wait for a key press before exit
en.watch list:
options:
  -h/--help     Show help

  --no-pause    Exit immediately when finished
  --pause       Wait for a key press before exit
en.watch reload:

  --no-pause    Exit immediately when finished

en.watch stop:
options:
  -h/--help     Show help

zh:
位置参数:
  extract (e)     解压压缩包
  watch (w)       管理监控目录和后台服务
  scan (s)        扫描归档并确认密码
  passwords (pw)  查看解压密码列表
  config (cfg)    查看或校验配置
  doctor (d)      检查安装环境
  version (ver)   查看版本号

选项:
  -h/--help       显示帮助
zh.extract:
位置参数:
  paths                              输入文件或目录

选项:
  -h/--help                          显示帮助
  -j/--json                          输出 JSON
  -v/--verbose                       显示详细信息
  --no-pause                         命令结束后直接退出
  --pause                            退出前等待按键
  -R/--recursive                     递归发现输入目录中的文件
  -d/--deep-detect                   扫描所有未确认文件中的嵌入压缩包，含递归轮次
  -p/--password PASSWORD             解压密码，可重复指定
  -P/--pw-file PASSWORD_FILE         密码文件，每行一个密码
  -a/--ask-pw                        交互输入密码
  --no-builtin-pw/--no-bpw           禁用内置密码表
  -r/--recur RECURSIVE_EXTRACT       解压轮数：正整数，* 无限，? 询问
  -c/--cleanup ARCHIVE_CLEANUP_MODE  原压缩包处理：d 删除，r 回收站，k 保留
  -o/--out-dir OUTPUT_DIR            输出根目录，默认当前目录
  -f/--flatten                       扁平化单一顶层目录
  -F/--no-flatten                    保留解压目录结构
  --direct-file/--direct             直接按压缩包分析输入文件
